record.title: JST SEH-001T-P0.6 — EH series crimp contact, AWG #30 to #22, phosphor bronze tin-plated (three per EHR-3 housing)
record.origin_why: Wire range, insulation range, material and reel quantity are transcribed from JST's eEH.pdf p.2 contact table; the part number is ROBOTIS' ('Crimp Terminal JST SEH-001T-P0.6', e-Manual XL330-M288-T §Connector Information). The envelope dimensions are READ off the p.2 drawing whose leader lines pdftotext drops, so their assignment is stated as a reading in cad/part.py. Not standard, not measured.
record.lifecycle_why: no lifecycle on eEH.pdf; no distributor page fetched.
record.why: The ELECTRICAL WINDOW is vendor-stated and is the load-bearing fact: AWG #30 to #22 (0.05 to 0.33 mm2), insulation O.D. 1.0 to 1.9 mm, 9,000 per reel, phosphor bronze tin-plated (eEH.pdf p.2). The SHAPE is an envelope read off a drawing whose dimension leaders were lost in text extraction (5.7 / 2.85 / 2.05 / 1.6 / 1.1 / 2 assigned by reading, cad/part.py docstring) — so the solid is CANNOT DETERMINE on form and is not offered as a fit check. THE FINDING: ROBOTIS' stated 21 AWG (0.4105 mm2 computed) exceeds this contact's published 0.33 mm2 maximum by 24 % — ledger row 1. What settles it: a stripped X3P lead under a micrometer; a vendor STEP or rendered drawing read with its leaders.

material.cite: eEH.pdf p.2 'Material and Surface finish, etc.'

crimp_tooling.value: crimping machine AP-K2N, applicator MKS-L, dies APLMK SEH001-06

record.where_on_the_microduck: 96 on the 16 X3P leads (3 per housing x 2 housings x 16 cables, wiring/cables.json group dynamixel-chain), bought crimped inside ROBOTIS' cable — a separate purchase only if leads are made in-house.
